aim: Check exact larval HOSTS plant binomial of independently first-indexed butterflies in six source VOC-route islands, requiring naturalized alien occurrence of same plant binomial in the island's source-matched GloNAF region AND historical commodity matches the plant genus.

sources.historical_route_cargo: voc_17c_cargo_on_verified_island_routes_v1.json (7 of 9 source-positive 1595–1698 routes have unambiguous 17th-century cargo records)
sources.HOSTS: globalbioticinteractions/HOSTS commit 808e0b869f9ec1adf8efff87cf6a395adda103e0, full 140485 source rows; GEB239 filter
sources.glonaf: Lenzner et al 2022 Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6640264 MD5 16f5585d2500676951a4b664bbf0ffde, 470962 source rows
sources.geography: TDWG official 369 level3 polygons, 52da7828aba9d461dd133c27b3bd7a4407161f54; 51-island WPI source crosswalk

GloNAF_source_spatial_matching.rule: Original GloNAF source polygon >=50% inside target WGSRPD region OR >=threshold fraction of target, equal-area EPSG:6933, same existing source-locked code

matching_rules: record of 2011–2017 butterfly first GBIF indexing on island, no HOSTS data used to define this outcome
focal recorded butterfly has an exact HOSTS genus + specific epithet binomial record (must be in fixed239 panel)
the exact plant binomial is an original GloNAF naturalized alien taxon canonical alias in the corresponding WGSRPD3 source region
plant genus is in originally precommitted commodity genus vocabulary for the ship's cargo category recorded on the original historic pair
unknown or missing GloNAF local match is NOT proof of plant species absence
JAP is all Japan (not only Kyushu); no island-specific inference for JAP species without finer source region
primary_outcomes: 7 source-cargo-positive routes with at least one island-specific recorded butterfly×exact larval-host plant species×GloNAF naturalized record×original VOC cargo genus concordance
7 routes with such concordance at BOTH ends
7 routes with the SAME first-indexed butterfly species and the SAME exact larval-host plant species catalogued as naturalized in BOTH GloNAF regions
exact matches separated by commodity category and island; empty/unknown source records kept
source_reuse_note: No new 17th century cargo rows will be uploaded or redefined based on modern butterfly outcomes
interpretation_ceiling: Same exact modern host species in a GloNAF naturalized flora and VOC commodity genus is STILL not evidence of shipment of that plant on the historic ship or voyage leg.
No detection date or naturalization year for source GloNAF species and no proved local larval use; 400-year sequence cannot be inferred.
Some source GloNAF and TDWG polygons cover broad areas; source plant records may not occur near the specific WPI port.
No negative inference from a genus or species unmatched by the historic or modern catalogues.
Nine source historic links and original 51-island host/GBIF positive evidence remain valid regardless of exact species source coverage.
